title: Principles Of Transport And Tourism
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a computerized system used to store and retrieve information and conduct transactions related to tour and travel."
IT-based ticketing and payment system is a computerized system used to store and retrieve information and conduct transactions related to tour and travel.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the bases of tourism, which takes place in various transport sectors that connect destinations, the connection between the development of transport and tourism is lopsided in the literature."

Despite the fact that traffic is one of the bases of tourism, which takes place in various transport sectors that connect destinations, the connection between the development of transport and tourism is lopsided in the literature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reflection of demand and supply."
Price is a reflection of demand and supply.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a shared passenger transport system that can be operated and owned either by a private or public company."
Public or private Public transport is a shared passenger transport system that can be operated and owned either by a private or public company.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the purpose of tourism promotion; it is part of the process which can influence the potential tourist to choose one destination in preference to another."
Matching markets to facilities is the purpose of tourism promotion; it is part of the process which can influence the potential tourist to choose one destination in preference to another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major challenges of our time and adds considerable stress to our societies and to the environment."
Climate change is one of the major challenges of our time and adds considerable stress to our societies and to the environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the Latin word torn us, meaning 'a tool for making a circle'."
The world 'tour' is derived from the Latin word torn us, meaning 'a tool for making a circle'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a web based application that users to check transportation access, buying and pay for transportation ticket on the web."
development is a web based application that users to check transportation access, buying and pay for transportation ticket on the web.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a predominant but invisible portion of total tourism activity."
Domestic tourism throughout the world is a predominant but invisible portion of total tourism activity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the world's fastest growing industries and a major foreign exchange and employment generation for many countries."
Tourism is one of the world's fastest growing industries and a major foreign exchange and employment generation for many countries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important factor in the destination choice of tourists (Maddison 2001, Lise and Tol 2002, Bigano et al., 2007b, Bigano et al. 2008)."
Climate is an important factor in the destination choice of tourists (Maddison 2001, Lise and Tol 2002, Bigano et al., 2007b, Bigano et al. 2008).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sense of nostalgia, not luxury."
The dominant experience is the sense of nostalgia, not luxury.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as an experience which in itself is tourist attraction and they include luxury, nostalgic, adventurous and other attractive transportation."
Mode of transport used is regarded as an experience which in itself is tourist attraction and they include luxury, nostalgic, adventurous and other attractive transportation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attraction which is tourism demand."
Transport itself is an attraction which is tourism demand.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount of a product people are willing to buy at a certain price."
The quantity demanded is the amount of a product people are willing to buy at a certain price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the minimization of direct human participation in the transaction process and its main business technology is the innovative management."
E-business feature is the minimization of direct human participation in the transaction process and its main business technology is the innovative management.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one the driver or the hirer has control over who is taken onboard and the route and destinations travelled to."
Private transport is the one the driver or the hirer has control over who is taken onboard and the route and destinations travelled to.
fib: ______ is any object, person, place, or concept that draws people either geographically or through remote electronic means so that they might have an experience.
attraction
An attraction is any object, person, place, or concept that draws people either geographically or through remote electronic means so that they might have an experience.
______ is a superstructure to include facilities constructed primarily to support visitation and visitor activities.
Particularly needed by tourism
Particularly needed by tourism is a superstructure to include facilities constructed primarily to support visitation and visitor activities.
______ is a part of the tourist experience, so it can have a positive or negative effect on the impact of tourist's stay at the destination, because it depends on the tourists and their experience.
Transport at tourist destinations

Transport at tourist destinations is a part of the tourist experience, so it can have a positive or negative effect on the impact of tourist's stay at the destination, because it depends on the tourists and their experience.
______ refer to the ability of a destination to provide social, physical, and economic benefits to the population, as well as a satisfying experience for tourists.
Supply and demand
Supply and demand refer to the ability of a destination to provide social, physical, and economic benefits to the population, as well as a satisfying experience for tourists.
______ refers to how much (quantity) of a product or service is desired by buyers.
Demand
Demand refers to how much (quantity) of a product or service is desired by buyers.
______ is a strategic question in tourist cities and regions.
mobility of visitors
The mobility of visitors is a strategic question in tourist cities and regions.
______ refers to the amount of certain goods producers are willing to supply when receiving a certain price.
quantity supplied
The quantity supplied refers to the amount of certain goods producers are willing to supply when receiving a certain price.
______ is the provision of the key elements of tourism industry by the host government and destination leadership.
Tourism supply
Tourism supply is the provision of the key elements of tourism industry by the host government and destination leadership.
______ is an important aspect of choosing a destination, but will always be constrained by the budget available to the potential tourist.
Relative attractiveness
Relative attractiveness is an important aspect of choosing a destination, but will always be constrained by the budget available to the potential tourist.
______ is a major consideration determining the demand for a destination.
Cost
Cost is a major consideration determining the demand for a destination.
______ is one of the major types of tourism that requires legal mobile documents before it can be achieved by tourists.
International tourism
International tourism is one of the major types of tourism that requires legal mobile documents before it can be achieved by tourists.
______ is a necessary requirement for the development of tourism in a destination, but it is not sufficient by itself.
well-developed transport infrastructure
A well-developed transport infrastructure is a necessary requirement for the development of tourism in a destination, but it is not sufficient by itself.
______ is the time one stays at destination which can be 'day trips or overnight' and lastly for 'any travel purpose' which covers the various forms of tourism.
Thirdly
Thirdly is the time one stays at destination which can be 'day trips or overnight' and lastly for 'any travel purpose' which covers the various forms of tourism.
______ is a long-term perspective which embraces the environmental, economic and socio-cultural aspects of tourism development (WTO 2004).
Essential to sustainable tourism development
Essential to sustainable tourism development is a long-term perspective which embraces the environmental, economic and socio-cultural aspects of tourism development (WTO 2004).
______ is a broad term that covers the factors governing the level of demand, the spatial characteristics of demand, different types of demand and the motives for making such demands.
Tourism demand
Tourism demand is a broad term that covers the factors governing the level of demand, the spatial characteristics of demand, different types of demand and the motives for making such demands.
______ is a prerequisite for the development of transport, because traffic consists of a number of individual transports and that makes its infrastructure an integral part of tourist trips.
Transport infrastructure

Transport infrastructure is a prerequisite for the development of transport, because traffic consists of a number of individual transports and that makes its infrastructure an integral part of tourist trips.
